preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the array n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element a_i in the array is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum sum of the final array.
